description:
Advances: ancora.derive

Stage: L7 part (a) (05a-stages-library.md; split per the refined plan decomposition note). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.ProjectInfo: resolved once in preflight purely from the target root; app: and elixirc_paths: read as literals from mix.exs via Code.string_to_quoted; dynamic elixirc_paths degrades to ["lib"] overridable by lib_paths config; apps_path present hard-fails as umbrella (tier=env); non-literal app hard-fails with message; no Mix.Project ambient reads anywhere downstream. Ancora.Derive.ModuleLocator: nesting-aware scan (track defmodule depth, prefix parent names) matching both defmodule and defprotocol, over lib_paths, per side: HEAD from working tree, base from same-path base blob then base blobs of change-set files. Documented limitation: dynamically created modules are invisible. Ancora.Derive.Membership: source-derived, per side (AR1); M is a member on side S iff the locator finds it under lib_paths on S; no .app reads, no _build reads, no env question.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.derive.project_info_from_root, membership_source_derived
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.derive.scenario.dynamic_elixirc_paths_degrade, umbrella_root_hard_fails, deleted_module_visible_at_base (membership half), nested_and_protocol_modules
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora from specled_ex; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: ProjectInfo consumed by Gate.Preflight (L9); Membership/Locator consumed by the resolver ctx (L7b) and Extract (L8); proving tests here are tmp-lib-tree fixture tests
  - Fixture hygiene: tmp lib trees built at runtime; no Mix.Project push/pop; no compiled fixtures; tests async
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (literal vs dynamic elixirc_paths, lib_paths override, apps_path, non-literal app; nested, protocol, base-only, HEAD-only modules)
- Call-site Integration: ProjectInfo is consumed by Gate.Preflight in L9 and passed as data to every pipeline module; Membership is consumed by resolver ctx construction in L7b. Proving tests now: ProjectInfo parse cases and membership/locator tmp-tree tests including a module present only at base (via git blob).

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/derive/{def_index,resolver,extract,compare,ack}.ex, lib/ancora/derive.ex (L7b/L8)
- lib/ancora/gate*, lib/ancora/output*, lib/mix/tasks/**
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/project_info.ex, lib/ancora/derive/module_locator.ex, lib/ancora/derive/membership.ex
- test/ancora/project_info_test.exs, test/ancora/derive/{module_locator,membership}_test.exs, test/fixtures/**, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.derive.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no .app or _build read, in any env, ever
- no Mix.Project.config or Mix.Project.umbrella? calls downstream of preflight
- no umbrella support engineering beyond the hard fail

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora passes (from specled_ex checkout)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
